Both `root>low>inner` and `root>high` are `position: absolute`, so their `z-index` values determine which one is painted on top in the overlapping area. `root>low>inner` has `z-index: 999`, while `root>high` has `z-index: 2`. Since `999 > 2`, the viewer sees `root>low>inner` in the overlap.

ANSWER: root>low>inner
